questions.question: A problem at work keeps returning, even after several quick fixes. What would you naturally do first?
questions.help: Choose the response closest to how you would approach it—not what you think a Business Analyst should say.

options.label: Look for patterns, investigate why it keeps happening and identify who is affected
Speak to the people affected and understand how the problem is disrupting their work
Apply the quickest workable solution so the team can keep moving
Escalate it to someone more senior and wait for their direction

questions.question: You receive an unclear request: “Can you improve this process?” What would you do first?
questions.help: This looks at how you respond when the real need has not yet been explained.
questions.revealAfter: Interesting. The way you respond to unclear problems can reveal analytical capability you may already use every day.

options.label: Clarify the underlying need, desired outcome, people involved and what success should look like
Make reasonable assumptions, begin the work and confirm the details later
Find a similar process and copy the approach that was used before
Wait until someone provides clearer instructions

questions.question: Which of these things have you done at work, during study, while volunteering or in everyday life?
questions.help: Choose every example that feels familiar. They count even if Business Analyst was never your job title.
questions.revealAfter: You may already have more transferable Business Analysis experience than your job title suggests.

options.label: Found a better way to do a task at work
Asked people what they needed before starting a task
Used figures, reports or patterns to help make a decision
Explained something complicated in a way others could understand
Looked into why the same problem kept happening
Balanced requests from people who wanted different things
Wrote clear instructions, notes or step-by-step guidance
Helped different people or teams work together
I have not done any of these yet

questions.question: A stakeholder says, “This system is terrible—we need a new one.” What would you investigate before accepting that solution?
questions.help: Choose the response that best reflects your natural next step.

options.label: The evidence, current process, user needs, root problem, constraints and desired outcome
The main symptoms, people affected and impact on the business
Which replacement systems are available and what features users want
Nothing further—the stakeholder has already confirmed that a new system is required

questions.question: Where are you currently in your Business Analysis journey?
questions.help: This helps us place your strengths and next move in the right context.

options.label: I’m exploring Business Analysis as a possible career move
I’ve started learning about Business Analysis
I’ve completed training but do not yet feel job-ready
I’m applying for BA roles but not receiving enough responses
I’m reaching interviews but not securing offers
I already perform BA-like work, even if Business Analyst is not my title

questions.question: What level of Business Analysis exposure have you had so far?
questions.help: This is not a BA knowledge test. Choose the option that most accurately describes your experience.

options.label: None yet
Informal learning through free content, reading or observation
Structured BA training or one formal course
Multiple BA courses or certifications
Real workplace experience using BA skills or responsibilities

questions.question: What is the biggest concern holding your BA transition back right now?
questions.help: Choose one priority. Your result will focus on this without overwhelming you with every possible gap.
questions.revealAfter: We’ve now identified a likely growth area and are connecting it with the strengths shown in your earlier answers.

options.label: I need more clarity about the BA role or where to begin
I struggle to translate my previous experience into BA value
I need practical BA experience and evidence
My CV, LinkedIn or applications are not positioning me strongly enough
I need stronger interview confidence and BA examples
I do not have a significant barrier right now

questions.question: When would you ideally like to make your transition into Business Analysis?
questions.help: This helps us understand urgency. It does not raise or lower your BA Readiness Score.

options.label: As soon as possible
Within 1–3 months
Within 3–6 months
Within 6–12 months
I’m exploring without a fixed timeline
